title: r3 chord gate (mouse.odin:188) has zero scenario coverage — no parity scenario scripts a same-frame right+left chord, so neither leg of the new Press_Anchor condition is pinned
detail: The delta narrowed Press_Anchor emission to chord-while-placing; the chord-while-not-placing suppression is a real r2->r3 behaviour change. No test executes either leg; reverting to the unconditional r2 condition leaves the suite green.
recommended_fix: Add a scenario scripting one frame with right+left press while placing (assert Cancel+Right_Click+Press_Anchor order) and one chord frame while not placing (assert no Press_Anchor, was_dragging latch preserved on a later release).

title: input-parity CLI arg-validation error leg untested — the new usage() rejection is never exercised by any gate or test
detail: The delta added the only validation on the input-parity verb; the rejection path (exit 2, no run) is P0 for CLI correctness but has zero coverage. The save path is exercised only by manual re-bless.
recommended_fix: Extend the ci-local input-parity gate to `tools/harness.sh input-parity && ! tools/harness.sh input-parity bogus` (expect non-zero), pinning the usage guard cheaply.
